The following events took place in '''4985 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*On [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], [[Ravilan Wroth]] and [[Seelah Korsin]] spread the toxic [[Cyanogen silicate]] in the [[Water/Legends|water]] supplies of [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] villages, claiming the lives of over 100,000 Keshiri.<ref name="LostTribe3">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref>
*The remaining 57 [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] survivors of the crash of ''[[Omen]]'' on Kesh are [[Red Sith Purge|killed]] by the order of [[Yaru Korsin]].<ref name="LostTribe3" />

==Deaths==
*On [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]
